transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I guess... man, I'm just here because I keep getting these intense flashes. They just hit me completely out of nowhere. It's like I'm right back in that crowded holding room, seeing that fight break out and hearing everybody get shoved hard against the wall. It’s so real. 

Like, it even happens when I'm just standing at a pickup counter for work. I do deliveries, you know, courier stuff. I was at this deli on 4th street yesterday—they make this massive pastrami thing, my buddy Dave swears by it, but honestly, their wait times are a total joke. You stand there for twenty minutes just for one little bag. And the parking? Don't even get me started on parking around 4th street. I got a seventy-dollar ticket there last month because the meter maid was just hovering like a hawk, I swear they hide behind the dumpsters just waiting for your time to expire... 

But anyway, wait, what was I saying? Oh, yeah. I'll just be standing there waiting for an order, totally normal day, and suddenly I'm just right back in that holding room.
Can you tell me more about these flashes? Do you find yourself re-experiencing the event in other ways, like nightmares or intrusive thoughts?

Yeah, the nightmares are... they're really bad. I barely sleep at all anymore. I'll maybe doze off for an hour, maybe two if I'm lucky, and then boom, I'm wide awake because of some dream about being stuck in that cell again, or just the sound of a heavy door slamming shut. It echoes, you know? 

Speaking of doors, the hinges on my apartment door have been squeaking like crazy lately. I asked my landlord, Mr. Henderson, to fix it like three weeks ago. He’s this older guy, always wearing these suspenders, and he just sits on the front porch smoking cigars all day. He keeps saying he'll get to it, but he never does. I even bought some WD-40 myself, the one with the little red straw, but I lost the straw the second I took the cap off. Why do they even make those straws so loose? You'd think with modern engineering they could attach it better. My buddy Dave—he's the one who likes that deli—he said I should just complain to the housing authority, but I don't want to start a whole thing, you know? 

But yeah, the sleep thing. I wake up from those dreams and I'm just drenched in sweat. By the time morning rolls around, I feel totally wrecked. It's getting dangerous honestly, because I'm so exhausted I can barely focus enough to drive my delivery route safely.

latest_inference.note: The patient's symptoms, including intrusive memories, nightmares, and significant sleep disturbance related to a traumatic event (being in a holding room where a fight occurred), point toward Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD). Other depressive disorder codes (F32.0-F32.9) are ruled out as the primary diagnosis since the trauma-related symptoms are predominant and better account for the clinical presentation.
